policy_statement: Threshold rule on unweighted household counts plus secondary suppression, verified by exact enumeration of the integer feasible set of the count constraints. No random noise is added and no differential-privacy guarantee is claimed.
withheld_derivatives: any ratio whose numerator or denominator is not public
notes: Cells marked 'suppressed' carry no values anywhere in this document.
Suppression follows a threshold rule on unweighted household counts plus secondary suppression; it is not differential privacy and no random noise was added.
Totals are union counts over households and are not the sum of overlapping audience cells.
Feasible ranges of suppressed cells and the blocking basis of refused releases are kept in the internal plan, not in this public file.
